title: Rebuttal's entire effect is unimplemented — resolves as a no-op.
expected: Card layer: /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json:4381-4383 has `"abilities": [null]` for ven-152-166 Rebuttal, and no per-card TS override exists (grep for "Rebuttal"/"ven-152-166" hits only ven.json). Running the runtime parser (packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/index.ts parseAbilities) on the rulesText yields a single spell ability with effect `{type:"raw", text:"You may pay :rb_rune_rainbow:. If you do, gain control of it ... Otherwise, counter it."}` — the "Choose a spell with Energy cost no more than [4]" targeting clause is dropped entirely (spells.ts:257/364 raw fallback), so no target/pendingChoice at play time. Engine: packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effect-executor.ts:165-177 dispatches via EFFECT_HANDLERS[effect.type]; "raw" has no entry in abilities/effects/index.ts, so it falls to the `// default: no-op` branch. Hence no choose-spell prompt, no pay-rainbow prompt, no counter/gain-control — matches observed behavior.
observed: Server card def has no abilities (ven.json abilities:[null]); chain item effect was {type:'raw', text:'You may pay :rb_rune_rainbow:. If you do, gain control...'}. No choose-a-spell prompt at play time (playSpell had no targets, pendingChoice null), no pay-rainbow prompt at resolution, Rebuttal went to trash and Called Shot stayed on the chain and then resolved normally (reveal-and-pick prompt appeared).

history.note: Rebuttal: explicit ven.json ability (pay-cost conditional -> gain-control-of-spell / counter) + pay-cost prompt in handle_conditional

resolution.note: Rebuttal: explicit ven.json ability (pay-cost conditional -> gain-control-of-spell / counter) + pay-cost prompt in handle_conditional
